48778-the-sea-fairies.title: The Sea Fairies
48778-the-sea-fairies.creator: Unknown
48778-the-sea-fairies.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In this book Dorothy, with Zeb, a little boy friend, and Jim, the Cab Horse, are swallowed up in an earthquake and reach a strange vegetable land, whence they escape to the land of Oz, and meet all their old friends. Among the new characters are Eureka, Dorothy's Pink Kitten, and the Nine Tiny Piglets.

arxiv-2002-05986.title: Out-of-time-order correlation and detection of phase structure in Floquet transverse Ising spin system
arxiv-2002-05986.creator: Rohit Kumar Shukla, Gautam Kamalakar Naik, Sunil Kumar Mishra
arxiv-2002-05986.description: Abstract We study the out-of-time-order correlation (OTOC) of the Floquet transverse Ising model and use it to verify the phase diagram of the system. First, we present the exact analytical solution of the transverse magnetization OTOC using the Jorden-Wigner transformation.

arxiv-2005-11816.title: Monitoring and Diagnosability of Perception Systems
arxiv-2005-11816.creator: Pasquale Antonante, David I. Spivak, Luca Carlone
arxiv-2005-11816.description: Abstract Perception is a critical component of high-integrity applications of robotics and autonomous systems, such as self-driving cars. In these applications, failure of perception systems may put human life at risk, and a broad adoption of these technologies relies on the development of methodologies to guarantee and monitor safe operation as well as detect and mitigate failures.

We outline a relation between the densities for the β \beta -ensembles with respect to the Jacobi weight ( 1 − x ) a ​ ( 1 + x ) b (1-x)^{a}(1+x)^{b} supported on the interval ( − 1 , 1 ) (-1,1) and the Cauchy weight ( 1 − i ​ x ) η ​ ( 1 + i ​ x ) η ¯ (1-\mathrm{i}x)^{\eta}(1+\mathrm{i}x)^{\bar{\eta}} by appropriate analytic continuation.

arxiv-2106-00298.title: Gaps between prime divisors and analogues in Diophantine geometry
arxiv-2106-00298.creator: Efthymios Sofos
arxiv-2106-00298.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Efthymios Sofos. Erdős considered the second moment of the gap-counting function of prime divisors in 1946 1946 and proved an upper bound that is not of the right order of magnitude. We prove asymptotics for all moments. Furthermore, we prove a generalisation stating that the gaps between primes p p for which there is no ℚ p \mathbb{Q}_{p} -point on a random variety are Poisson distributed. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 14G05, 60F05; 11K65.

arxiv-2106-08629.title: From Discourse to Narrative: Knowledge Projection for Event Relation Extraction
arxiv-2106-08629.creator: Jialong Tang, Hongyu Lin, Meng Liao, Yaojie Lu, Xianpei Han, Le Sun, Weijian Xie, Jin Xu
arxiv-2106-08629.description: Abstract Current event-centric knowledge graphs highly rely on explicit connectives to mine relations between events. Unfortunately, due to the sparsity of connectives, these methods severely undermine the coverage of EventKGs. The lack of high-quality labelled corpora further exacerbates that problem.

arxiv-2202-05751.description: Abstract . GitHub Sponsors, launched in 2019, enables donations to individual open source software (OSS) developers. Financial support for OSS maintainers and developers is a major issue in terms of sustaining OSS projects, and the ability to donate to individuals is expected to support the sustainability of developers, projects, and community.

arxiv-2412-10697.title: Wojciech Młotkowski
arxiv-2412-10697.creator: Instytut Matematyczny
arxiv-2412-10697.description: Abstract Partial Chebyshev Polynomials and Fan Graphs Abstract Motivated by the product formula of the Chebyshev polynomials of the second kind U_{n}(x) , we newly introduce the partial Chebyshev polynomials U^{\mathrm{e}}_{n}(x) and U^{\mathrm{o}}_{n}(x) and derive their basic properties, relations to the classical Chebyshev polynomials, and new factorization formulas for U_{n}(x) .

arxiv-2601-21000.title: UrduBench: An Urdu Reasoning Benchmark using Contextually Ensembled Translations with Human-in-the-Loop
arxiv-2601-21000.creator: Muhammad Ali Shafique, Areej Mehboob, Layba Fiaz, Muhammad Usman Qadeer, Hamza Farooq
arxiv-2601-21000.description: Abstract Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have led to strong reasoning capabilities; however, evaluating such models in low-resource languages remains challenging due to the lack of standardized benchmarks. In particular, Urdu reasoning evaluation has been limited by the sensitivity of machine translation and an emphasis on general language tasks rather than reasoning benchmarks.

pmc-11286865.title: Chemo-, regio- and enantioselective hydroformylation of trisubstituted cyclopropenes: access to chiral quaternary cyclopropanes
pmc-11286865.creator: Shuailong Li, Dequan Zhang, Aiswarya Purushothaman, Hui Lv, Shilpa Shilpa, Raghavan B Sunoj, Xiuxiu Li, Xumu Zhang
pmc-11286865.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Catalytic asymmetric synthesis of polysubstituted chiral cyclopropane presents a significant challenge in organic synthesis due to the difficulty in enantioselective control. Here we report a rhodium-catalyzed highly chemo-, regio- and enantioselective hydroformylation of trisubstituted cyclopropenes affording chiral quaternary cyclopropanes. Importantly, the easy made sterically bulky ligand L1 can effectively suppress hydrogenation and decomposition reactions and give quaternary cyclopropanes with high regio- and enantioselectivities for both aryl and alkyl functionalized substrates.

pmc-11368695.title: Skeletal muscle-on-a-chip in microgravity as a platform for regeneration modeling and drug screening
pmc-11368695.creator: Soochi Kim, Bugra Ayan, Mahdis Shayan, Thomas A Rando, Ngan F Huang
pmc-11368695.description: SummaryMicrogravity has been shown to lead to both muscle atrophy and impaired muscle regeneration. The purpose was to study the efficacy of microgravity to model impaired muscle regeneration in an engineered muscle platform and then to demonstrate the feasibility of performing drug screening in this model.

pmc-11393774.title: Closely related species differ in their traits, but competition induces high intra‐specific variability
pmc-11393774.creator: Eva Janíková, Marie Konečná, Aleš Lisner, Markéta Applová, Petr Blažek, Anna E‐Vojtkó, Lars Götzenberger, Jan Lepš
pmc-11393774.description: Theories explaining community assembly assume that biotic and abiotic filters sort species into communities based on the values of their traits and are thus based on between‐species trait variability (BTV). Nevertheless, these filters act on individuals rather than on species. Consequently, the selection is also influenced by intraspecific trait variability (ITV) and its drivers. pmc-11478512.title: Effects of Acute and One-Week Supplementation with Montmorency Tart Cherry Powder on Food-Induced Uremic Response and Markers of Health: A Proof-of-Concept Study
pmc-11478512.creator: Drew E Gonzalez, Jacob A Kendra, Broderick L Dickerson, Choongsung Yoo, Joungbo Ko, Kay McAngus, Victoria Martinez, Megan Leonard, Sarah E Johnson, Dante Xing, Ryan J Sowinski, Christopher J Rasmussen, Richard B Kreider, Marilyn Cornelis
pmc-11478512.description: Metabolic conditions, such as gout, can result from elevated uric acid (UA) levels. Consuming high-purine meals increases UA levels. Therefore, people with hyperuricemia typically must avoid ingesting such foods. Polyphenols have been shown to reduce uric acid levels and tart cherries (TCs) are a rich source of phenolic and anthocyanin compounds.

pmc-11535390.title: Postmortem evidence of decreased brain pH in major depressive disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11535390.creator: Hideo Hagihara, Tsuyoshi Miyakawa
pmc-11535390.description: IntroductionMajor depressive disorder (MDD) is a prevalent and debilitating mental disorder that shares symptoms, genetics, and molecular changes in the brain with other psychiatric disorders, such as schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. Decreased brain pH, associated with increased lactate levels due to altered energy metabolism and neuronal hyperexcitation, has been consistently observed in schizophrenia and bipolar disorder.

pmc-11624223.title: Neurodegeneration in the cortical sulcus is a feature of chronic traumatic encephalopathy and associated with repetitive head impacts
pmc-11624223.creator: Raymond Nicks, Arsal Shah, Spiro Anthony Stathas, Daniel Kirsch, Sarah M Horowitz, Nicole Saltiel, Samantha M Calderazzo, Morgane L M D Butler, Kerry A Cormier, Nurgul Aytan, Fatima Tu-Zahra, Rebecca Mathias, Farwa Faheem, Suzie Marcus, Elizabeth Spurlock, Lucas Fishbein, Camille D Esnault, Alexandr
pmc-11624223.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Neurodegeneration is a seminal feature of many neurological disorders. Chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) is caused by repetitive head impacts (RHI) and is characterized by sulcal tau pathology. However, quantitative assessments of regional neurodegeneration in CTE have not been described. In this study, we quantified three key neurodegenerative measures, including cortical thickness, neuronal density, and synaptic proteins, in contact sport athletes (n = 185) and non-athlete controls (n = 52) within the sulcal depth, middle, and gyral crest of the dorsolateral frontal cortex.

pmc-12634180.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-12752073.title: Cost-effectiveness analysis of datopotamab deruxtecan versus docetaxel for previously treated advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-12752073.creator: Fanxu Zeng, Shuishi Li, Pengbo Deng
pmc-12752073.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe advent of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) has significantly reshaped therapeutic strategies for lung cancer. However, given their exceptionally high treatment costs, evaluating whether their clinical benefits justify these expenses is crucial, highlighting the need for robust economic assessments.

pmc-13026966.title: Myrtenol from Lavender Essential Oil Possesses Neuroprotective Effects and Promotes Neurite Outgrowth by Potentially Targeting TrkA and IGF-1R in PC12 Cells
pmc-13026966.creator: Ting Jiang, Lan Xiang, Jianhua Qi
pmc-13026966.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is a prevalent chronic neurodegenerative disorder; the progression of this disease is driven by cellular determinants such as oxidative stress and dysregulated neurotrophic signaling. Lavender essential oil is traditionally used in aromatherapy for neuronal regulation and neuroprotection, suggesting its potential neuroprotective effects for chronic neurodegenerative disorders like AD.

pmc-13079979.title: Humanized extracellular vesicles for efficient RNA delivery
pmc-13079979.creator: Xiang Ma, Sophia R. Zhao, Constance L. Cepko
pmc-13079979.description: SignificanceWe developed engineered extracellular vesicles (EVs) as RNA delivery vehicles to address limitations of virus-like particles (VLPs) and lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) in gene therapies and vaccines. We first developed an assay for individual active particles, using methods typically employed for viral titrations. This approach allowed iterative optimization of a modular EV platform.

pmc-13191343.title: Repeated semaglutide treatment attenuates cocaine-vs-food choice in male and female rats
pmc-13191343.creator: Nicholas Heslep, Samuel A Marsh, Matthew L Banks
pmc-13191343.description: The present study determined the effectiveness of the glucagon-like peptide 1 agonist semaglutide to attenuate cocaine-vs-food choice in male and female rats. Repeated 5-day semaglutide treatment decreased cocaine choice and significantly reduced body weight. These preclinical results support the clinical evaluation of semaglutide as a candidate cocaine use disorder medication.

pmc-13326668.title: Unparalleled nanofibril hydrogel actuators by mimicking nature's design
pmc-13326668.creator: Farhiya Alex Sellman, Rebecca Östmans, Tobias Benselfelt
pmc-13326668.description: Soft actuators aim to bridge the gap between rigid machines and soft matter by mimicking the flexibility and compliance of natural muscles and tissues. Stimuli-responsive hydrogels can fit this purpose through their softness and ability for large reversible shape morphing.

pmc-13507546.title: Effects of Dietary Schizochytrium species powder on Broiler Growth Performance, Blood Parameters, and Gut Microbiota
pmc-13507546.creator: Tingting Yang, Linna Gui, Jianing Wang, Shiman Zhao, Ruoying Wang, Jianbin Zhang, Hui Wang, Fenglong Cai, Hua Yang, Lei Pu, Liang Hong, Shunyi Qin
